date.as_written: munirandhai samudraiśca, yute nepālavatsare | bhādra ca sitapakṣetu, dvitīyāyāṃ ravaudine

notes: The chronogram 'muni-randhra-samudra' yields 497 (muni = 7, randhra = 9, samudra = 4) by the standard rule of aṅkānāṃ vāmato gatiḥ (ce_approx 1377 CE), though the catalogue interprets it in direct order as 794(!) (ce_approx 1674 CE).
